clf-avc-097.text: A technical auditor needs to investigate a safety incident in which a Security Group were improperly altered to 02h00 of the morning, exposing instances EC2 The auditor wants to find out exactly the name of the user of IAM, the IP address of origin and the exact command of API used to effect this modification. AWS provides these detailed audit records and tracking of control plan actions?
options: Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
AWS Trusted Advisor.
AWS Configure.
AWS CloudTrail.
clf-avc-097.explanation: The AWS CloudTrail record and continuously monitor all call activities from API executed in the account, recording fundamental metadata such as the identity of the invocation, time, IP of origin and the parameters of the executed command.
clf-avc-097.hint: Think of the service whose main scope is to generate an uninterrupted audit trail for each administrative action and request executed via Console, CLI or SDK.
optionRationales: The AWS CloudTrail record and continuously monitor all call activities from API executed in the account, recording fundamental metadata such as the identity of the invocation, time, IP of origin and the parameters of the executed command.

The CloudWatch Logs centralizes text logs from operating systems and internal applications, but is not the service natively responsible for the normative tracking of calls from API governance of the control plan of the AWS.

The AWS config monitors the timeline of the configuration state and the logical resource relationships, showing 'what has changed in the resource', but does not natively capture raw call data from API from whom the IP and credentials request was made.

The Trusted Advisor monitors infrastructure against best practices of AWS, issuing security advisory alerts, but it doesn't work as a forensic repository of transaction history and log calls from API.

clf-avc-098.text: A software company is setting up permissions for its junior technical support team. According to the Principle of Minor Privilege (Least Privilege), how the security administrator should structure the access policies of IAM for this team?
options: Grant strictly limited permissions to view and read only the services properties needed to perform your daily tasks.
Attribute the Admin policyTemporary access and review monthly logs of CloudTrail to remove accesses that analysts did not use.
Create rules based on global access keys without expiration date shared between the junior team.
Configure a general public Bucket Policy to mitigate logical errors in denied access (AccessDenied) on a daily basis.
clf-avc-098.explanation: The principle of the lowest privilege states that identities should receive only the minimum essential permissions to perform their necessary functions, preventing destructive actions or accidental access to confidential data.
clf-avc-098.hint: This fundamental concept focuses on reducing the radius of exposure to faults and improper access by providing the minimum of operational technical power required.
optionRationales: The principle of the lowest privilege states that identities should receive only the minimum essential permissions to perform their necessary functions, preventing destructive actions or accidental access to confidential data.
Allow full access (AdministratorAccess) to then remove excess violates frontally good security practices, creating an unacceptable risk window in the account.
Sharing static access keys breaks the traceability of actions and severely increases the risk of catastrophic leaks of permanent credentials.
Making general public resources or permissions to simplify operational work removes key perimeter security barriers from the account.

clf-avc-099.text: An application running in an instance EC2 needs to read and record data periodically in a private pocket of Amazon S3. Following the best practices of AWS IAM and mitigating the use of long-term credentials (Access Keys), which strategy the architect should adopt to grant this permission to the body with security?
options: Add instance EC2 within a IAM Group configured with full access to Amazon S3.
Generate root user access keys and save them within a hidden configuration file in the instance.
Configure the Bucket S3 to allow general public anonymous access from any public internet IP.
Create a IAM Role with access permissions to S3 and associate it with the instance EC2 through a IAM Profile Forum.
clf-avc-099.explanation: Associate one IAM Roll to an instance EC2 allows the application to use temporary credentials automatically renewed by itself AWS, eliminating the need to embed static security keys in the code.
clf-avc-099.hint: Search for the component of IAM tailored to confer temporary and dynamic identities and access to cloud resources and services.
optionRationales: Associate one IAM Roll to an instance EC2 allows the application to use temporary credentials automatically renewed by itself AWS, eliminating the need to embed static security keys in the code.
Embed root user credentials on virtual servers creates a severe vulnerability vector, as it compromises the full control of the account if the server suffers an invasion.
Exposing a private pocket for anonymous internet access removes all security and governance controls required by technical regulations.
The IAM Groups serve exclusively to organize and manage permissions from human users, being technically impossible to add instances or hardware resources within groups.

clf-avc-100.text: A bank wants to migrate its Pix payment system to instances of the Amazon EC2. Under the guidelines of the Shared Responsibility Model of the AWS, which of the following tasks resides under direct and total control of the bank's engineering team?
options: Configure traffic rules for Security Group and encrypt the transactional data trafficted within the application.
Replace degraded hard drives or manage controlled physical destruction of magnetic media in data centers.
Update the virtualization software (hypervisor) that sliced the logical features of the physical server processors.
Ensure uninterrupted electrical supply and redundant diesel generators of industrial buildings AWS.
clf-avc-100.explanation: Cloud security requires the client to properly configure virtual logical firewall permissions (Security Groups), control the access of identities and guarantee the protection and encryption of your data.
clf-avc-100.hint: Remember that everything that involves the code, stored data and logical configurations of the features created by the console is the customer's duty.
optionRationales: Cloud security requires the client to properly configure virtual logical firewall permissions (Security Groups), control the access of identities and guarantee the protection and encryption of your data.
Mechanical maintenance, exchange of defective physical parts and safe ecological disposal of storage media are exclusive responsibilities of the AWS.
The management and application of patches in the low-level physical virtualization layer belong to the global infrastructure maintained by AWS (cloud security).
The perimeter security, air conditioning and stable supply of electricity to the physical facilities of global data centres are strictly responsible for the AWS.

clf-avc-101.text: The security architect of a holding manages multiple accounts using the AWS Organizations. It needs to structure interchangeable central compliance barriers (guardrails) to ensure that no test account can exit the Frankfurt region or disable the CloudTrail, even if the engineers of these accounts have total administrative privileges, which resource meets this centralized demand?
options: Resource-based Policies (RMPs) configured in the IAM locations of each account.
Configure mutual authentication based on hardware cryptographic keys through the AWS Identity Center.
Rules of Network ACLs Numberings applied Internet Gateway main VPC payer.
Service Control Policies (SCPs) applied at the root of the Organization or Organisational Units (ORs).
clf-avc-101.explanation: The SCPs determine the maximum permitted permissions for an organization's member accounts. SCP restricts actions even for local users configured with AdministratorAccess policy.
clf-avc-101.hint: Look for the corporate resource of AWS Organizations focused on defining the maximum ceiling of logical limits of lawful access to daughter hierarchical structures.
optionRationales: The SCPs determine the maximum permitted permissions for an organization's member accounts. SCP restricts actions even for local users configured with AdministratorAccess policy.
Local logical policies of the IAM may be freely altered, mocked or revoked by local administrators of these accounts, not serving as central observatories.
The AWS IAM Identity Center centralizes unique login management (SSO) of corporate employees, but does not have technical assignments to restrict service API call limits.

The NACLs filter network packages in the network transport layers (IP/Porta) of specific sub-networks, without visibility or regulatory control over administrative requirements of the control plan of the AWS.

clf-avc-102.text: An electronic commerce organization wants to migrate its environment to the AWS and wants to completely isolate corporate billing resources from team code development resources. They chose to use the AWS Organizations creating multiple accounts AWS. What is a security and billing benefit generated by this multi-account strategy?
options: Automated mandatory reduction of all public Internet data transfer rates to zero in all accounts.
Automatically mix all routing tables and permissions from IAM in a homogeneous and inseparable way.
Strict isolation of resources, limitation of the radius of exposure (blast radius) against logical incidents and consolidation of collections in a single unified invoice.
Transfer responsibility for patch updates of instances software EC2 entirely for the team of the AWS.
clf-avc-102.explanation: Adopt multiple accounts under the AWS Organizations restricts the impact of potential invasions to isolated environments, delimits employee access and centralizes corporate accounting through consolidated billing.
clf-avc-102.hint: Think of how to separate sensitive corporate environments into separate accounts protects the company against a widespread human error that can take down the whole operation.
optionRationales: Adopt multiple accounts under the AWS Organizations restricts the impact of potential invasions to isolated environments, delimits employee access and centralizes corporate accounting through consolidated billing.
The creation of multiple accounts does not extinguish the standard charges associated with data traffic exit (Data Transfer Out) to the public internet.
Each account AWS maintains its own logical network isolated control plan and IAM; o Organizations provides hierarchical control, maintaining beneficial isolation of resources.
The isolation of accounts does not change the Shared Responsibility Model; patches of operating systems in IaaS instances continue under customer governance.

clf-avc-103.text: After creating a new account AWS for a startup, the Security Engineer has set up the initial login. Following strictly the pillars of good security practices recommended by AWS for the account root user, which of the following actions should be avoided?
options: Enable multiple factor authentication (MFA) using a physical hardware device or token generator application.
Generate long-term program access keys (Access Keys) for Root user and use them in daily CI/CD treadmill automation scripts.
Use Root user credentials exclusively to perform rare and specific administrative tasks (such as changing support plans)).
Configure a complex alphanumeric password and store it in a secure institutional security box.
clf-avc-103.explanation: Root user access keys grant total, permanent and irreversible powers. Creating and exposing these credentials in daily scripts is a dangerous practice that violates the fundamental recommendations of AWS.
clf-avc-103.hint: Root user has unrestricted and irreversible administrative privileges over billing and resource exclusion; their programmatic credentials should never be generated or exposed.
optionRationales: Root user access keys grant total, permanent and irreversible powers. Creating and exposing these credentials in daily scripts is a dangerous practice that violates the fundamental recommendations of AWS.
Enable MFA protects the Root user against invasions in emptied corporate password scenarios, being one of the main initial safety recommendations.
Maintaining Root's credentials under strong complex protection restricts undue access and is aligned with required compliance in IT audits.
Root user must be isolated and accessed only for critical operations that require supreme privileges of the account owner.

clf-avc-104.text: A senior developer needs to update an infrastructure automation script. By trying to execute the command through the CLI of AWS at its local terminal, the API of the Amazon S3 returns a denied access error ('AccessDenied'). To investigate which explicit permissions are blocking the request or missing in the developer's profile, what service the AWS should be consulted in search of audit logs containing the details of this rejection?
options: AWS Systems Manager Configurer.
AWS CloudTrail.
Amazon Inspector.
AWS Artifact.
clf-avc-104.explanation: The AWS CloudTrail captures all interactions of API and records detailed logs showing whether the request was successful or rejected due to lack of permissions (AccessDenied), identifying the cause of structural failure..
clf-avc-104.hint: Consider the service in charge of documenting and cataloging chronologically each command sent to the endpoints and backends of the services of the AWS.
optionRationales: The AWS CloudTrail captures all interactions of API and records detailed logs showing whether the request was successful or rejected due to lack of permissions (AccessDenied), identifying the cause of structural failure..
The Inspector performs automated scans in search of logical vulnerabilities of installed software packages or exposed network vulnerabilities, without recording user API call audit.
The AWS Artifact it stores international compliance reports and audits of the data centre infrastructure of the AWS, without interacting with daily operating log accounts of customers.
This component of the Systems Manager manages parameterization and patches of server fleets, not acting as the official repository of audit trails of the cloud control plan.

clf-avc-105.text: A financial institution uses the AWS Organizations to control the accounts of its subsidiaries. The Director of Compliance required that all member accounts record their activities in the AWS CloudTrail In order to prevent local administrators of these daughter accounts from deactivating the log track or deleting the bank's pocket, the bank's bank account is not subject to any restrictions. S3 where the logs are saved, which centralized strategy should be adopted by the main paying account?
options: Enable advanced DDoS protection using the AWS Shield Standard in the network interface of VPC payer.
Create a Service Control Policy (SCP) containing a Deny for stock cloudtrail:StopLogging and s3:DeleteBucket, applying it to the root of the organization.
Attach a customer-managed policy directly to the user groups of the IAM Member accounts.
Move all logical log resources into the AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.
clf-avc-105.explanation: The SCPs they function as supreme security filters. By applying an explicit denial rule (Deny) for destructive commands of CloudTrail and S3, the child accounts administrators lose the technical power to disable the logs.
clf-avc-105.hint: Think about the governance and organizational control component of AWS overlapping mandatory restrictions above any local permission granted in the IAM.
optionRationales: The SCPs they function as supreme security filters. By applying an explicit denial rule (Deny) for destructive commands of CloudTrail and S3, the child accounts administrators lose the technical power to disable the logs.
Policy IAM managed locally in daughter accounts can be modified, circumvented or revoked by engineers who have privileges of local admin.
The Shield Standard operates by mitigating automated external network volumetric attacks on layers 3 and 4, without relation to the logical governance of user permissions of the IAM.
The Parameter Store serves exclusively as repository of parameterization strings and software environment variables, without having security functions or storage of tracks of the CloudTrail.

clf-avc-106.text: During a process of restructuring IT teams, the IT manager IAM has received the task of ensuring that 50 new database analysts receive the same strict reading permissions in Amazon RDS. What is the approach recommended by AWS to manage these permissions with the least operational effort and maximum governance efficiency?
options: Create a IAM Group called 'Analysts'-RDS', attach the necessary permission policies to that group and add the 50 users as its members.
Configure a Resource-based Policy on the Console of RDS and manually list the public IP of each analyst.
Attach the inline access policy individually in each of the 50 user profiles of the IAM Manually.
Generate a single pair of permanent access keys (Access Keys) and share them via corporate email with all 50 analysts.
clf-avc-106.explanation: Use IAM Groups allows the centralization of permission management. Any change in the policy attached to the group is automatically inherited by all members, reducing administrative effort and mitigating human failures.
clf-avc-106.hint: Remember the component of the control plan IAM specifically designed to group identities of users who share similar access needs in the company.
optionRationales: Use IAM Groups allows the centralization of permission management. Any change in the policy attached to the group is automatically inherited by all members, reducing administrative effort and mitigating human failures.
Attaching policies manually in dozens of users generates high operational effort, hinders future audits and raises the risk of maintaining orphan or misaligned permissions.
Sharing permanent static credentials prevents the identification of those who have carried out certain actions and violates the fundamental principles of compliance and security audit.
The Amazon RDS does not support policies based on resources directly attached to the classical relational database such as the S3 makes this strategy impossible.

clf-avc-107.text: A startup wants to deploy a web application using microservices in Docker containers managed through the Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS). According to the Shared Responsibility Model of the AWS for container-based services, whose responsibility is for the physical maintenance of the server hardware and the layer of the hypervisor that supports the underlying infrastructure?
options: It is the customer's total responsibility (startup)).
It's a task that is synchronously divided, where the client installs the physical hardware patches and the AWS monitors the electrical sources.
It is the responsibility of the local public internet provider contracted by the client's corporate hospital.
It is of total and exclusive responsibility to the AWS.
clf-avc-107.explanation: A AWS manages cloud security, which includes data centers, raw hardware installations, physical networks and primary virtualization software (hypervisors), regardless of the service model consumed.
clf-avc-107.hint: The deep insulation of the hardware layers and the security patches of the basic virtualization software of the multi-tenant clouds are safeguarded by the provider.
optionRationales: A AWS manages cloud security, which includes data centers, raw hardware installations, physical networks and primary virtualization software (hypervisors), regardless of the service model consumed.
The customer assumes the governance over the data, the code of the applications inserted in the containers and the logical policies of access control configured in IAM.
Local connectivity partners provide external network access links without any management or control over the internal hypervisors or hardware of the AWS.
The customer does not have physical or logical access to the data centers of the AWS to perform maintenance on plates or processors of the underlying racks.

clf-avc-108.text: A DevSecOps engineer needs to set up an automation mat. He needs to ensure that the deployment script has permissions to create instances EC2, but only if the requisition is triggered within business hours ( 09:00 at 18:00) and coming from the private IP block of the company headquarters. JSON no IAM manages the validation of these external data and IP restrictions?
options: Effect).
Condition (Condition).
Action).
Resource).
clf-avc-108.explanation: The 'Condition' block in a policy statement of the IAM specifies the rules and circumstances under which the policy grants or denies permission, validating context keys such as IPs of origin, dates or authentication MFA active.
clf-avc-108.hint: Think of the optional block of a structured policy of the IAM used to impose fine and contextual safety validation criteria before releasing the command.
optionRationales: The 'Condition' block in a policy statement of the IAM specifies the rules and circumstances under which the policy grants or denies permission, validating context keys such as IPs of origin, dates or authentication MFA active.
The 'Effect' element determines only whether the policy will result in an explicit permission ('Allow') or imperative denial ('Deny') for listed actions.
The Resource block explicitly identifies the technical objects of AWS (using RNAs such as pocket RNAs or instances) on which actions will be applied.
The 'Action' element lists the specific API commands for services from AWS (as ec2:RunInstitutions) which are being controlled by legal policy.
